description: List the posts on the brand's WordPress site, newest first — published, scheduled, drafts, pending and private — each with its id, status, title and live URL. Free. WordPress publishes no per-post view counts, so this carries none.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

status.description: one status or a comma list: publish, future, draft, pending, private (default all)

name: list_wordpress_posts
title: List WordPress posts
